description: Defines a Drupal render element class for the Layout Builder UI, including methods for rendering, form processing, and layout management.

classes.name: Drupal\layout_builder\Element\LayoutBuilder
classes.description: Defines a render element for building the Layout Builder UI, including methods for rendering, form processing, and layout management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event dispatcher service.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Provides info for the render element, including pre_render and process callbacks.

methods.name: layoutBuilderElementGetKeys
methods.description: Stores element parents in the form and sets pre_render and post_render callbacks.

methods.name: renderLayoutBuilderAfterForm
methods.description: Pre_render callback that renders the layout builder element to markup and saves it.

methods.name: addRenderedLayoutBuilder
methods.description: Post_render callback that appends the layout builder markup to the form HTML.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render callback that renders the layout UI if section storage is provided.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Renders the layout builder UI, including sections and add links.

methods.name: prepareLayout
methods.description: Dispatches an event to prepare the layout for UI rendering.

methods.name: buildAddSectionLink
methods.description: Creates a link to add a new section at a specified delta.

methods.name: buildAdministrativeSection
methods.description: Builds the render array for a section while editing, including blocks and controls.
